metadata.title: Supra Interact | Mafi Kyakkyawan Mai Ma'amala da Smart Contract
metadata.description: Kwararrun mai ma'amala da smart contracts, yanayin gwaji, da kuma kayan aikin mu'amala waɗanda aka gina musanya ga tsarin Supra. Haɗa walat ɗinka, bincika modules, ka kuma aiwatar da ma'amoli ba tare da matsala ba a kan Testnet da Mainnet.
metadata.keywords: Supra, Blockchain, Smart Contracts, Explorer, DApp, SupraOracles, Move Language, Web3, Hoglet DAO

Governance.factoryNotPublished: Babban masauyin sarakaina ba a wallafa ba tukuna. Sanya NEXT_PUBLIC_GOVERNANCE_FACTORY zuwa adireshin kayan aiki da ka wallafa.
Governance.statusHint: An karanta daga karkashin kai, ba daga abin da ke yake fa'amar kansa.
Governance.statusUnmanaged: Babu canza — maɗin shi yana aiki, kuma babu wani ya samu ikon
Governance.statusRenounced: An manta — babu wani zai iya yin amfani da shi karfi sake
Governance.statusDaoGoverned: DAO ke sarre — maɗin babba ya gone, kuma DAO ita ce sarre
Governance.statusHazard: Karafata: maɗin yana aiki, don haka DAO za a iya watsi da shi
Governance.factImmutable: Kai za a canza shi kuma ba sake
Governance.factCryptoFrozen: An lalata kowane hanya na yin amfani
Governance.emptyHint: Sanya adireshin kowane don ya sani cewa ke ya mallake shi: ko maɗin shi yana aiki, wa ya sarre shi, ko tsohon za a canza shi.
Governance.hazardDetail: Maɗin babba na wannan adireshin yana aiki, don haka mai ru shi zai iya watsi da DAO: yi aiki shi kadai ko sake daukar ikon. Ka kawai kirji shi da ba da sauri sai maɗin ya lalata.
Governance.burnBody: Wannan shi ne matan da ke sa komai sama ya zara ya kasance na harab. Yana lalata maɗin babba na wannan adireshin dazawa sifiri. Bayan haka, babu wani zai iya yin amfani da shi karfi — ba kai ba, ba wani ba.
Governance.burnAssetWarning: Kowane kudi, kayan fansa ko NFT da yake cikinsa a cikin wannan adireshi za a iya babu amfanin da shi har abada. Kana amfanye a kashe asusun da farko.
Governance.burnGateSwept: Na fitar da duk dukan kayan daga wannan adireshi.
Governance.burnGateUnderstood: Na fahim cewa za a lalata maɗin babba da harab ba tare, kuma ba za a iya sake dawo shi.
Governance.burnDoneHint: Maɗin yanzan sifira ne yanzu. Sabunta halin don ka ga san inda wannan adireshin ya tsaya: an manta na harab, ko DAO ke sarre shi ba tare da jimawa.
Governance.burnFailed: Ba a iya aika da sauya maɗanin ba
Governance.stage_dual_master: Matsayi 2 · kai da ka DAO za su iya yin amfani
Governance.stage_governed: Matsayi 3 · DAO kadai za ta iya yin amfani
Governance.stage_frozen: Matsayi 4 · babu wani zai iya yin amfani
Governance.factFactoryManaged: An yi rijista a wannan masauyi
Governance.runnerConnectWallet: Hauɗi walat don gudu rayuwa a kan adireshinka.
Governance.runnerUnmanagedBody: Babu wani aka wallafa a kowane wannan tukuna. Ƙirƙiri babba ba tare da maɗin ba ka haɗa shi da DAO.
Governance.runnerDualMasterBody: Maɗin yana aiki, don haka yana iya tsayawa da DAO. Lalata shi a kasa don yin wannan na harab.
Governance.runnerDualMasterContractsBody: The master key still works, so it can still override the owner. That is an account-level hazard: destroying the key lives in Account Control, not here.
Governance.runnerGovernedBody: Maɗin ya shanye, kuma DAO ita ce sarre. Akwai sabuntawa, canza hulda, da rufe na karshe.
Governance.runnerFrozenBody: Babai da sake za a canza wannan. Babu maɗin, babu ikon, kuma babu jimawa ga kowane.
Governance.deployFormHint: Yana ƙirƙiri sabu kowane ba tare da maɗin ba, kuma yana sa DAO ta kashe shi.
Governance.fieldDaoAdminHint: Adireshin da zai mallaki wannan kwangila. Shi ne admin a kan sarkar, kuma shi kaɗai zai iya sabunta lambar, yin watsi da ita har abada, ko mika ta. DAO, multisig ko timelock a nan shi ne ke mayar da shi rarrabacce — wallet ɗinka yana aiki, amma sai ka riƙe iko kuma DAO ba zai sami ra'ayi ba.
Governance.fieldMetadataHint: package-metadata.bcs daga babban faldi na build.
Governance.fieldNewAdminHint: Mika mallaka ga DAO, timelock ko multisig.
Governance.transferFormTitle: Yi mayar da muƙin mai gadinwa
Governance.transferFormHint: Mataki daya mai atomic. Babu tabbatar da kuma biyu, don haka kuskure ba za a iya gyara shi ba.
Governance.transferFormWarning: Idan sabon mai gadinwa ya yi kuskure ko ba a iya isa shi ba, babu wani da zai iya sake sarƙewa.
Governance.upgradeTargetMismatch: An haɗa wannan fakitari don {target}, ba don asusun da ake haɓakawa ba ({contract}). Sake sunan fakitari don ya samo wannan asusun.
Governance.deepFreezeFormHint: Yana wallafa sabu na ƙarshe na lambar a kan {address}, sannan yana lalata kowane hanya na yin amfani da shi.
Governance.deepFreezeFormWarning: Sigar da za a tafi a nan za ta kasance ta har abada. Bayan haka ba za a iya sake sabunta kayan aiki ba.
Governance.deepFreezeFormAck: Na fahimci cewa wannan bytecode shi ne karshe kuma ba za a maye shi ba.
Governance.sealToggleHint: Publish this version and freeze the contract forever. Nothing - not you, not a later version of the factory - can ever change it again.
Governance.renounceFormHint: Yana lalata kowane hanya na yin amfani da {address}, da harab.
Governance.renounceFormWarning: An lalata kowane hanya na yin amfani kuma an janye handoff. Babu wani zai iya mayar da shi, ba tare da babban sarki na factory na yanzu.
Governance.donateFormTitle: Ba da wannan kowane zuwa ga DAO
Governance.donateFormHint: Ma'amala daya. Masauyi da kansa yana kira `offer_signer_capability` na framework a madinka — abin da kake buƙata shi ne shaidar aika wacce maɗanin sirrinka kaɗai zai iya samarwa.
Governance.donateSignHint: Yana karanta lambar jeri da wannan ma'amala za ta cinye, kuma yana saƙin kayan da framework ke tabbata.
Governance.donateSubmitHint: Yana rijista aika a masauyi domin DAO ta iya sarƙe wannan adireshi.
Governance.donateProofNote: Saƙi ne kawai. Babu gas, babu ma'amala. Aikan na aika ma'amalar kyauta ɗaya da ke ɗauke da shi.
Governance.burnFrameworkOnly: Masauyi ba zai iya yin wannan a madinka ba. `rotate_authentication_key_call` an ayyana ta `entry` (ba `public` ba) a framework, don haka Move ya hana kiranta daga wata modul — mai maɗanin ne kaɗai zai iya aika ta kai tsaye. Sauran matakai na wannan rayuwa, kwangila ke tsara su, domin ayyukan da yake buƙata na public ne.
Governance.burnOwnerOnly: Mai shi kaɗai zai iya lada wannan maɗanin, don haka haɗa walat ɗin wannan adireshi.
Governance.burnModalTitle: Ba za a iya juya wannan ba
Governance.selfRenounceTitle: Ko kuma manta wannan kowane na harab
Governance.selfRenounceBody: Lalata maɗin tare da babu DAO. An manta kowane na harab: babu wani za ta iya canza shi, babu wani zai iya yin amfani da shi, kuma babu sabo a factory. Ka sani hana rufe hanya DAO: bayan maɗin ya shanye, ba za ka iya sake ba shi ga DAO ba.
Governance.cancelDelegationBody: Ya janye handoff: yana sake daukar ikon da ka ba da shi, kuma yana manta waƙawa, don haka za a iya sake ba ta ga DAO. Yi amfani da shi idan ka zaɓi DAO ko kuma ka ba shi daga wallet ba daidai.
Governance.cancelDelegationWindow: Za a iya kawai sai maɗinka yana aiki. Wannan shi ne hatarin da lalatar maɗin ke kaɗawa — bayan maɗin ya shanye, handoff ya zama na harab, kuma DAO kadai zai iya manta ikon.
Governance.cancelDelegationOwnerOnly: Mai wannan maɗanin ne kaɗai zai iya soke tafiarmarsa, don haka haɗa walat ɗin wannan adireshi.
Governance.cancelDelegationDoneHint: Ikon ya koma zuwa gare ka, kuma za a iya sake ba da wannan kowane zuwa ga DAO a kowane lokacin.
Governance.cancelDelegationFailed: Ba a iya soke tafiarmar ba
Governance.burnGatesHint: Danna duka shaidu biyu a sama don ci gaba.
Governance.burnReauditHint: Yana sake karanta sarkar don nuna sabon matan. Ba a aika komai ba.
Governance.termEoa: EOA — kowane da aike maɗin ke ke sarre shi. Kawai shi ne kowane da wallet dinka ke sautin hannu.
Governance.termAdmin: Matsayin da ke kan sarkar wanda ya mallaki kwangila: adireshin da kaɗai zai iya sabunta lambarsa, yin watsi da shi har abada, ko mika shi. Fuskokin nan suna kiransa mai kwangila.
Governance.termRenounce: Zanye al'awali — manta ikon da sake, don babu wani (hatta kai) zai iya yin amfani da wannan adireshin karfi sake.
Governance.termCapability: Karfi — hakar ake ajiye na yin amfani da kowane. Babu abin da ba shi kalma sirri, za a iya lalata shi har abada.
Governance.termImmutable: Mai za a canza — babu wani zai iya canza ko ingiza sabo kowane, ba tare.
Governance.glossaryTitle: Mane ma'ana ne mukan za'udan kalmomin shan'ewa?
Governance.donateNeedAdmin: Cika mai kwangilar a sama da farko - sa hannun ba shi da amfani ba tare da shi ba.
Governance.donateProofValid: Hannu yana daidai da adireshin da yanzu. Yana tsayar da canza ma'ayen da ke sama; kawai sabu ma'amari zai iya sanya ta ba daidai.
Governance.donateOneDelegate: Kowane daya, daya daya. Idan wannan kowane yana kan DAO, ba da shi ga wata DAO za ta kuma daukar ikon daga ta — sannan janye tafiyar da ta yanzu.
Governance.burnBlockedTitle: Kuma ka lalata maɗin ba tare
Governance.burnBlockedBody: An kowane wannan an bayyana ga DAO, amma tafiyar da ta ba ta nuni zuwa ga batir na wannan factory — yanzu wani dabba shi ne. Idan ka lalata maɗin ba za ka sake dawo shi: janye tafiyar yana buƙatar maɗin da za ka lalata.
Governance.burnBlockedHint: Kuma dawo ikon ga DAO ko kuma canza kowane zuwa ga DAO da kake sarre. Lalatar maɗin a nan ba za ya sake komai — yana kawai yin hasara ta zara ta kasance na harab.
Governance.hubContractsSubtitle: Wallafa wani babba ba tare da maɗin ba, haɗa shi da DAO, sabunta shi, ko rufe shi da harab.
Governance.hubAccountsSubtitle: Ba da wannan kowane zuwa ga DAO, ko sake daukar ikon, ko lalata maɗin don babu wani zai iya sake.
Governance.runnerAccountUnmanagedBody: Babu wani yana da nauyi da wannan kowane tukuna. Ba shi ga DAO, ko lalata maɗin don sake amfani ba sake.
Governance.runnerAccountGovernedBody: Maɗin ya shanye, kuma DAO ita ce sarre wannan kowane. Babu wani za ka iya yi a nan: canza abin da kowane ke gurbida shi, gabanin saƙa ne.
Governance.otherSurfaceBody: An kowane wannan an bayyana ga DAO. Ayyuka da wannan hali sun belongu ga Gabanin kowane, wanda aka yi shi da gida shi.
Governance.contractAuditHint: Sanya adireshin ƙoƙarin. Za ka sa hannu da wallet da ke yafi da shi na admin — kuma su kan wadannan ne kuma ba daidai.
Governance.flowDonateTitle: Yaya ake aika ya aika kowane
Governance.flowDonateStep1: Za ka sa hannu sau da. Ana koyar daƙin hannu a wataƙinƙari sabu da kuma babu komai a ciki: babu lambar, babu modulu, sai dai hakcin yin amfani da kanka.
Governance.flowDonateStep2: Yanzu factory za ta iya yin amfani da kowane: sabunta abin da ke gurbida shi, rufe shi, ko manta shi da harab — kuma kawai DAO da ka zaɓi za ta iya nema haka.
Governance.flowDonateStep3: Maɗinka yana aiki, don haka komai za a iya janye: za ka iya sake daukar wannan hakci sai maɗin ya riga yana rayuwa.
Governance.flowDeployTitle: Yaya ake aika ya koyar ƙoƙari
Governance.flowDeployStep1: An wallafa lambarka a cikin kowane da aka yi daga adireshinka, saboda haka yana faɗu wuri daya kowane lokacin, kuma ka san wannan adireshin kafin ka gina.
Governance.flowDeployStep2: Admin na DAO da ka zaɓi yana ɗau bayan daga farkashin bai. Shi ne kawai adireshin da za a iya sabunta shi, rufe shi, ko manta shi.
Governance.flowDeployStep3: Babu wani ya zara ba tukuna. Za ka iya sabunta shi, canza shi zuwa ga wata DAO, ko rufe shi da harab — ƙoƙarin yana riƙe admin saƙansa kowane lokacin.
Governance.flowDonateWarning: Factory za ta iya yin amfani da wannan kowane, kuma za ka iya sake daukar wannan karfi — amma sai ne idan maɗinka yana rayuwa. Lalatar maɗin shi ne wanda ke sa wani abu ya zama na harab: factory ba ta riƙe abin da kai ba, saboda ba a ta ba ta maɗin ba, kawai wataƙiya.
Governance.flowDeployWarning: Wannan kowane ba tare da maɗin da shi ba, don haka admin na DAO shi ne kawai hanya shiga. Zaɓi shi da hankali — kuma za ka iya canza shi nan ba, ko rufe ƙoƙarin don ya sake canza ba.
Governance.workspaceSeedHint: Optional. Empty uses the package name; otherwise it must be a valid package name (letters, digits, _). Use it to reproduce the address a contract was deployed under.
Governance.workspaceNeedAddress: Haɗa wallet dinka don a sani adireshin manufa da wannan fakitari.
Governance.workspaceBadPath: Babban ƙoƙari ya zai yi kamar sources/Name.move
Governance.workspaceNeedOne: Fakitari yana buƙatar ƙoƙari daya aƙalla
Governance.workspaceNoFile: Babu fayil da aka za a iya
Governance.workspaceNote: An adana shi a wannan browser kuma za a ci gaba a kan wannan kowane. Yiƙƙiri kyauta ne kuma ba ya wallafa komai; buga shi ne ke yake rubuta a kan chain.
Governance.deployManualFiles: Yiƙƙiri a nan yana dawo da IDs ƙoƙari, ba bytecode da ake buƙatar ba. Sanya fitarar ɗan don sann don wallafa.
Governance.workspaceRegenerateToml: Dawo dawowar bayanan da aka ƙirƙira
Governance.workspaceTomlBrokenTitle: Wannan bayanan ba za a iya wallafa
Governance.workspaceTomlBrokenHint: Adireshin da aka yana buƙatar ta kasance wannan fakitari a za a wallafa ({address}). Wani adireshin zai yiƙƙiri cikin sauƙa sannan ya gagule a kan chain bayan ka sa hannu. Za ka iya ci gaba da gyara sauran bangare, kamar ƙara waniƙin dogara.
Governance.workspaceTomlWarnTitle: Duba abubuwan da kake dogaro da su
Governance.workspaceTomlWarnHint: Sabis ɗin yana buƙatar rev da aka kafa don kowace dogaro kuma yana duba ƙungiyar da kansa. Waɗannan bayanan game da sake ginawa ne; duk abin da ya ƙi yana zuwa da nasa dalili.
Governance.workspaceBadName: Yi amfani da suna kamar Pool, ko cikakken hanya kamar sources/Pool.move
Governance.workspaceAdvancedHint: Leave these on default for a normal compile. Included artifacts (none is the smallest) trims what the on-chain package metadata carries, for a large package. Override size check lets the service hand over artifacts past its size cap.
Governance.workspaceSaveQuota: Ajiyar wannan browser na wannan shafi ya cika. Fitar da aikin don kiyaye aikinka.
Governance.workspaceSaveBlocked: Wannan browser yana hana ajiya (yanayin sirri ko kuma an toshe kukis). Fitar da aikin don kiyaye aikinka.
Governance.workspaceFrameworkNoise: {count} sanarwa daga tushen framework — ba fayilolinka ba ne, kuma za a iya watsi da su.
Governance.workspaceImportFailed: Ba a iya karanta wannan zaɓi a matsayin fakitari na Move ba.
Governance.workspaceImportEmpty: Wannan zaɓin ba shi da fayilolin .move ko .toml. Zaɓi babban fayil ɗin fakitar, ko zaɓi tushensa kai tsaye.
Governance.workspaceImportSkipped: An tsallake fayiloli {count}: ba su dace da tsarin fakitari ba.
Governance.deployNeedAdmin: Shigar da adireshin mai kwangilar a sama.
Governance.deployImmutableToggle: Make it immutable from the start
Governance.deployImmutableHint: Publishes the package and freezes it in the same transaction - no owner is kept.
Governance.deployImmutableWarning: No owner will be set. This contract is frozen the moment it is published: nobody, not even you, can upgrade or renounce it later.
Governance.deployNeedMetadata: Bayanan fakitari ba su nan. Sanya package-metadata.bcs daga fitarar ginin ka.
Governance.deployNeedBytecode: Bytecode na modulu ba su nan. Yiƙƙiri a sama yana dawo da IDs, ba bytecode da ake buƙata ba — sanya fayilolin .mv daga bytecode_modules/.
Governance.workspaceArtifactsOmitted: An yiƙƙiri fakitari, amma kayan sa sun wuce iyakar 8 MB ta sabis kuma ba a dawo da su ba. Fitar da aikin ka gina shi a gida don wallafa.
Governance.workspaceDeployTargetHint: Kowane da za a wallafa wannan fakitari a ciki. An samu shi daga adireshinka da sunan fakitari, don haka kowane suna yana da nashi.
Governance.workspaceTemplateBasicHint: Ayyuka biyu da shigo da daya: ya isa a kira wani abu ka karanta sakamako.
Governance.workspaceTemplateFullHint: Yana kara agogon sarkar da entry da ke fitar da event, don haka za ka iya aika ma'amari ba karatu kawai ba.
Governance.deployTargetTaken: Wannan sunan fakiti yana da kwangila a {address} tuni. Sanya ɗaya ga kowane sunan fakiti, don haka wallafa sabon lamba yana nufin inganta shi — wannan yana cikin Sarƙin saƙa.
